note: Rewritten from the species-level Diagnosis in Chhotani's monograph, the original in English; the original records the species as Neotermes bosei Snyder (published in 1933 as Kalotermes (Neotermes) bosei). OCR problems: the original length 1^ times that of width is 1½ times; Pig- 2B is Fig. 2B; c 17-18 is about 17—18 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head chestnut brown, body brown. Head capsule nearly circular, wider at the compound eyes than long to the mandible bases (length 1.5—1.6 mm, width 1.7—2.0 mm), coronal suture distinct; compound eyes large, nearly circular, diameter 0.65—0.67 mm; ocelli oval, large, touching the compound eyes; antennae 17—18-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 or sometimes equal; pronotum as wide as the head, anterior margin distinctly incurved, posterior margin nearly straight; wings transparent, without tubercles. Body length about 17—18 mm with wings, about 8.5—10.5 mm without wings.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale reddish brown, body straw yellow. Head capsule nearly rectangular, 1½ times as long as wide (length 2.9—4.0 mm, width 2.2—2.5 mm), coronal suture indistinct; eye spots small, oval; antennae 14—16-segmented, segment 3 strongly sclerotized, as long as segment 2 or longer; mandibles robust, 1/2—2/3 the length of the head without mandibles, the left mandible with 5 marginal teeth and the right with 2; postmentum long, club-shaped, the club indistinctly lobed or not lobed; pronotum flat, nearly rectangular, anterior margin broadly incurved, posterior margin nearly straight. Body length 9.5—12.00 mm.
